home.lede: A king-of-the-hill shooter in the browser. You pilot an eight-foot armored robot, a MAD, with one AI squadmate, and hold a pit in no-man's-land against human infantry. First side to 100 points wins.

how.title: How it is won
how.text: A side scores while it holds the pit alone: one point for every 0.9 seconds. Hold it, or clear it and take it back. The match ends when a side reaches 100.

levels.title: Three levels

war.text: 8 hostiles, with heavier and tighter fire.

levels.note: You pick the level on the game's menu. The choice is remembered on this device.

aim.text: Aim. Click to fire, right-click for the sight.

touch.title: Phone or tablet
touch.text: Hold the device sideways. The left thumb moves and the right thumb aims. There are buttons for Fire, Sight, Thrust, Load and pause.

made.title: What it is made of
made.text: One page, Three.js r128 and two fonts, all served from this site. Nothing is sent anywhere to play, and there is no account to make. Once this app has loaded, the game opens with no network.
made.note: The game opens as a page of its own, outside this app's frame. Its menu has no link back here: use the browser's Back.
